item.title: Official entry info for Botswana was updated (Nov 6, 2026)
item.description: UK government note: "Updated information about the documents needed when travelling with children (see 'Travelling with children' on the 'Entry requirements' page)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
